messages.text: I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Added reduced motion overrides to [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css) and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css). Cards now skip their border transition and the win banner skips its pulse when reduced motion is enabled; normal motion stays unchanged.

The existing browser test covers both behaviors. I didn’t run tests.
